Satellite name MOVE (First-MOVE, Munich Orbital Verification Experiment)
Form factor CubeSat
Units or mass 1U
Status Reentry 2026-02-26. Was operational until 2013-12-21. On-Board Computer damaged and only name is sent.
Launched 2013-11-21
NORAD ID 39439
Deployer ISIPOD [ISISpace]
Launcher Dnepr
Organisation Technical University of Munich (TUM)
Institution University
Entity type Academic / Education
Nation Germany
Launch brokerer ISILaunch
Oneliner

Educational training and CubeSat platform development and testing solar cells.
Description

Test triple junction GaAs / Ge Solar Cells (EADS Astrium). One focus of the CubeSat project will be on training the students involved. The gained experience should be maximized by model-based development of the system in conjunction with hardware integration.
Failure cause On-Board Computer damaged and only name is sent.
